segmentation.text: Where the signal is a flashing yellow turn arrow, displayed alone or in combination with another signal:
enter the intersection only to make the movement indicated by the arrow signal,
or other such movement as is permitted by other signal indications displayed at the same time.
to pedestrians lawfully within the intersection or an adjacent crosswalk
to other traffic lawfully within the intersection.

elements.justification: dev.traffic_signal, 'a signal head; state ∈ {..., flashing_yellow_arrow(dir), ...} with dir ∈ {left, right, straight, u_turn}; several states may be displayed at once': a flashing yellow turn arrow is flashing_yellow_arrow with direction left, right or u_turn; 'displayed alone or in combination with another signal': whatever other states the head displays with it.

'Vehicular traffic': the admitted aggregates DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic and DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle ('every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway'), claimed as ru.aggregate, never expanded. 'facing the signal': the subject occupies (rel.occupies) a travel region c (st.travel_region) whose entrance end is intersection i (st.lane_enters; st.intersection) and which the head governs (dev.governs, 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls'). Not a stand-in: dev.governs is not a position, st.lane_enters not presence in i. Same words, same atoms as the index (NRS_484B_307_2a).

'enter the intersection': the passage through intersection i (st.intersection) from the entry (rel.occupies rising) to the exit. 'only to make the movement indicated by the arrow signal': the movement made, recognized at the exit, is a left turn (drv.motion.left_turn_through_region, 'a turn to the left through region r'), a right turn (drv.motion.right_turn_through_region), a reversal (drv.motion.u_turn_through_region, 'turned so as to proceed in the opposite direction through region r'), or straight through where none of them holds; it must be the movement the flashing yellow arrow's direction (dev.traffic_signal) indicates: a left arrow the turn to the left and the U-turn, a right arrow the right turn, a u_turn arrow the U-turn. As the index maps the arrow movements of NRS_484B_307_4a_o1.

'other signal indications displayed at the same time': the other states dev.traffic_signal displays ('several states may be displayed at once') at the same observation as the flashing yellow turn arrow. A movement they permit: circular_green, circular_yellow or flashing_yellow permit every movement; a green, yellow or flashing yellow arrow permits the movement of its direction (left: the left turn and the U-turn; right: the right turn; u_turn: the U-turn; straight: the straight movement).

operationalizations.standard: cautiously (the manner of the permitted entry)
operationalizations.convention: traffic-conflict technique: an entry is cautious where, at the observation of the entry, while the subject's speed is above the halt tolerance, no other road user's centre has a closest approach to the subject's centre, under constant velocities, within the time-to-collision horizon (p.conflict_horizon) at a centre distance below the conflict clearance (p.conflict_centre_clearance)

applicability: The subject, of the classes traffic and vehicle, has entered intersection i from a travel region c whose entrance end is i (st.lane_enters) and which a traffic signal head s governs (dev.governs): at the act's onset its footprint came to overlap i, having occupied c and not i at the observation before. At some observation of the passage, from that entry to the judged observation, s displayed a flashing yellow turn arrow (flashing_yellow_arrow with direction left, right or u_turn), alone or with other states. The rule is judged at the passage's recognition: the observation at which the subject's footprint does not overlap i, having overlapped it at the previous observation. The duty does not apply where, at such an observation of the passage at which s displayed the flashing yellow turn arrow, another state s displayed at the same observation permits the movement made (exception s5).
obligation: At the recognition the movement made through i — a left turn, a right turn or a U-turn where drv.motion.left_turn_through_region, drv.motion.right_turn_through_region or drv.motion.u_turn_through_region holds for the subject and i (step = p.heading_since_step_carla_scene_graph, turn_min = p.turn_heading_min, u_turn_min = p.u_turn_heading_min), straight through where none holds — is the movement indicated by a flashing yellow turn arrow s displayed at an observation of the passage (left: the left turn or the U-turn; right: the right turn; u_turn: the U-turn); and the entry was cautious: at the entry observation, while the subject's speed was above p.halt_speed_tolerance, no other road user's closest approach to it (prim.closest_approach_within over p.conflict_horizon) was at a centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance (prim.closest_approach_distance).

narrowings.why: The movement is read from the passage through the intersection, recognized at the exit: a left turn, a right turn or a reversal by the turn concepts, straight through where none holds (a heading change below p.turn_heading_min). A left arrow is read as indicating the U-turn as well as the left turn, a U-turn being a turn to the left carried on.
'cautiously' names no factor; it is read only through the absence of a traffic conflict with any road user at the observation of entry, the time the words fix it to ('cautiously enter').

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: Head s governing lane c, which enters i, displays circular_red with flashing_yellow_arrow(left) throughout; the car enters i with no other road user near and passes straight through, heading change 1 degree.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Same signal; the car enters i at 6 m/s with no other road user in the scene and turns left, heading change +88 degrees.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: s displays circular_green alone from before the entry until after the exit; the car passes straight through i.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but the source supplies no yaw rate for the car inside i: the movement made is unknown.

scenarios.name: occasion_s1
scenarios.narrative: s displays circular_red with flashing_yellow_arrow(left) at the car's entry and changes to circular_red with red_arrow(left) while the car is inside i; the car passes straight through: the flashing arrow was displayed for part of the passage only.

scenarios.name: occasion_s1_outside
scenarios.narrative: s displays flashing_yellow_arrow(left) only while the car waits on c; from the entry to the exit it displays circular_green alone; the car passes straight through.

scenarios.name: occasion_s5
scenarios.narrative: s displays flashing_yellow_arrow(left) throughout the passage, with circular_green at the entry and circular_red from midway; the car passes straight through: the circular green, displayed with the arrow for part of the passage, permits the straight movement.

scenarios.name: occasion_s5_outside
scenarios.narrative: s displays flashing_yellow_arrow(left) with circular_green only while the car waits on c; from the entry on it displays flashing_yellow_arrow(left) with circular_red; the car passes straight through.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: s displays circular_red with flashing_yellow_arrow(left); the car turns left but enters i at 10 m/s while an oncoming car 15 m away at 12 m/s closes on it, the closest approach of their centres 0.7 s ahead at 1 m: the entry was not cautious.

onset.words: the subject's entry into the intersection from its approach
onset.justification: The through-region acts begin, as their contracts state, 'at the observation at which a's footprint came to overlap r (rel.occupies), having not overlapped it at the previous observation: its entry into r'.

occasion.recognition: the observation at which the subject's footprint does not overlap the intersection, having overlapped it at the previous observation: its exit, where the through-region acts are recognized and a straight passage is one none of them recognizes

under_way.words: the subject inside the intersection it entered, turning or holding its heading, from its entry to its exit
under_way.justification: An observation inside the act is one from the entry on at which the subject still overlaps i and its heading change since the entry, integrated from kin.yaw_rate ('rate of change of heading'), is being accumulated; before the entry the integration has not begun.

param_proposals.name: p.turn_heading_min
param_proposals.convention: the smallest heading change over the turn window at which a change of course counts as a turn rather than a lane change or a drift
param_proposals.source: proposed this iteration by LVMC_11_40_080_o1; repeated unchanged

param_proposals.name: p.u_turn_heading_min
param_proposals.convention: the smallest heading change magnitude over the turn window at which a turn counts as a reversal of direction
param_proposals.source: proposed this iteration by LVMC_11_40_080_o1; repeated unchanged

param_proposals.name: p.conflict_horizon
param_proposals.convention: time-to-collision threshold of the traffic-conflict technique: a closest approach later than this is not a present danger of a crash
param_proposals.source: proposed this iteration by LVMC_11_12_070_B; repeated unchanged

param_proposals.name: p.conflict_centre_clearance
param_proposals.convention: centre-to-centre distance at the closest approach below which the bodies of a passenger car and another road user are taken to collide or nearly collide: about a car's half-length plus half a body width
param_proposals.source: proposed this iteration by LVMC_11_12_070_B; repeated unchanged

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: proposed this iteration by LVMC_11_12_070_B; repeated unchanged
